messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: can't google "hmecology google group"
parts:
Dear all,

here's a mind-boggling problem I have with Google: when I google "hmecology google group", then I get a single hit, which is to some particular message rather than the main page of this group. And when I select that URL, then I get a page that says "Content unavailable" 🙁 So, I can't access the group on the internet, even though I can send emails like this one .... Who has the same astonishing problem ?

I am in Switzerland and just tried out on two different laptops and with Firefox and Edge: same behaviour for all.

Thanks and best regards  --- Marc
